description: Enables AI assistants to perform quantum-resistant cryptographic operations using NIST-standardized algorithms including ML-KEM, ML-DSA, and SPHINCS+. Supports key generation, encryption, digital signatures, and security analysis for post-quantum cryptography research and development.
